exercises.title: Balance it: Maple Run closing
exercises.intro: Build Maple Run's settlement statement line by line until sources equal uses.

buildup.context: Maple Run closes on 15 Jan 2027. Price $300,000. Closing costs $9,000 (title, recording, legal, appraisal). Commitment $340,000 at 10.25%, with 1.50 points. Initial advance $240,000 (RES-FF-01). No escrows. Prepaid interest runs from the funding day, counted, to month-end (CORE-CLS-04).

lines.label: Origination points
lines.hint: 1.50 × $340,000 ÷ 100 (F-CORE-06). Points are on the commitment, not the advance.

lines.label: Days of prepaid interest, 15 to 31 Jan
Borrower cash at the closing table
lines.hint: $74,100 + prepaid interest. Maple Run has no escrow.

lines.label: Total sources
lines.hint: $240,000 advance + the borrower's cash. It must equal total uses.

exercises.title: Cedar Court funding wire
exercises.intro: Net Cedar Court's charges out of the initial funding to find the wire to the closing agent.

calculator.task: Cedar Court funds on the last day of the month, so 1 day of prepaid interest. Check it first: $4,340,000 × 7.65% ÷ 360 × 1. Then read the wire. Try wiring the full $4,340,000 and see why that is wrong.

exercises.title: Wire check: spot the red flag
exercises.intro: It is Cedar Court's funding day. Sort each fact: does it stop the wire, call for a slower check, or allow release?

items.text: At 3 p.m. the title agent emails new wire details "because of an audit".
items.why: Details changed after our instructions went out. Call the number in our file and send it to the BSA officer the same day (CORE-KYC-07).

items.text: The receiving account name differs from the CPL agent's escrow account.
items.why: The account must match the CPL agent's escrow account (CORE-CLS-03).

items.text: You confirmed the details by calling the phone number printed in the request.
items.why: A call-back must use a number already in our file, never one from the request (CORE-KYC-07).

items.text: The funding checklist shows every condition cleared, but nobody has signed it.
OFAC was last run at approval, two weeks ago.
items.why: OFAC is re-run on the funding day, before funds move (CORE-KYC-01, CORE-CLS-03).

items.text: The agent asks you to rush the wire out before 2 p.m.
items.why: A rush request is a common fraud sign. Policy does not list it as a stop, so verify by call-back (CORE-KYC-07).

items.text: A known contact at the title agent writes from a new email address.
items.why: A new email address is a common fraud sign, not a listed stop. Verify by a call to the number on file.

items.text: Details match our instructions and the CPL escrow account, confirmed by a call to the number on file. OFAC was re-run this morning.
items.why: Every CORE-CLS-03 control is met. A second person releases the wire, then receipt is confirmed by the number on file.

items.text: A colleague prepared the wire. You, a second person, release it after the checks pass.
items.why: One person prepares and a second releases (CORE-CLS-03).
